Title: The Azure Sphere OS 20.05 quality release is now available

Body.Content:
The Azure Sphere OS 20.05 quality release is now available in the retail feed. This update includes changes to strengthen OS security by reducing the denial-of-service attack surface. It does not include an updated SDK.

For more information on Azure Sphere OS updates, see What’s new in Azure Sphere.

Learn more about Azure Sphere OS feeds.

If you need help, contact your Microsoft technical account manager or Azure Support. If you have product-related questions, join the Microsoft Developer Network forum, or ask your development-related questions on Stack Overflow.
